We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Procurement Operations Coordinator to support the accurate processing, tracking, and reporting of purchase orders across multiple customer projects.

This role serves as a critical link between Project Management, Finance, and external clients ensuring procurement workflows run smoothly, data integrity is maintained, and client expectations are met.

While initially supporting the New York City Department of Education portfolio, this role is designed to scale across Gordian’s growing customer base.

Process, track, and reconcile purchase orders across customer and Gordian systems, ensuring accuracy and alignment to project budgets
Serve as the primary point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders on PO status, updates, discrepancies, and resolution
Maintain complete and audit-ready procurement records and documentation to support compliance and financial reporting
Monitor PO activity across contracts and project portfolios, proactively flagging risks, variances, or delays
Drive continuous improvement by identifying workflow gaps and recommending process enhancements that improve speed, accuracy, and operational efficiency
Support internal teams in achieving customer goals and key performance metrics through timely and accurate procurement execution
Manage competing priorities across multiple projects while maintaining strong client relationships and service delivery standards

Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience in Business, Supply Chain Management, or related field
3+ years of experience in Procurement, Purchasing, Contract Administration, or Project/Construction Management
Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a customer service orientation
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
Self-motivated with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team

Experience with ERP systems and reporting tools
Proficiency in Power BI and/or Smartsheet
Familiarity with public sector procurement processes
Work Location & Schedule
This is a remote position open to candidates located nationwide
Must be available to work Eastern Time zone business hours
Minimal travel required

In this role, you will sit at the intersection of recruiting, operations, and strategy—and plays a critical role in scaling and sustaining Steno ’s nationwide network of court reporters. Who are you?

We’re looking for a results-driven recruiting and operations leader who thrives in fast-paced environments and loves building scalable systems. You’re equal parts strategic and hands-on, comfortable owning metrics, and energized by growing and supporting a high-performing team.

You’re biased toward action, quick to learn new industries, and relentless about finding better ways to hit your goals. Most importantly, you care deeply about building meaningful relationships with providers and creating an exceptional onboarding experience.

If you’re looking for a company that offers support, guidance, an abundance of killer giphys, and unlimited potential to grow into your best self, you can bet we’d love to have you too.

About the Role: The People Operations Coordinator - Global is responsible for delivering a seamless and high-quality employee experience across the full employee lifecycle.

This role serves as a key operational partner, ensuring timely support for employee inquiries, accurate data management across systems, and smooth coordination of onboarding and offboarding processes.

With a strong focus on detail, organization, and service, the Coordinator helps maintain compliance, operational efficiency, and a welcoming experience for employees. What You’ll Do: Serve as the primary point of contact for all People Operations inquiries via Jira ticketing, email, and other sources ensuring adherence to service level agreements.

Provide tier 1 People Team support such as answering employee questions, people team systems user support, complaint/employee relations intake, verifications of employment, etc.

Properly escalate tier 2 People Team support - such as complex issues requiring interpretation and items needing local expertise - to appropriate People Operations team members or engage cross-functional partners as needed.

Responsible for People Operations onboarding tasks including but not limited to: processing onboards in HCM ensuring data accuracy, auditing new hire data against applicant tracking system, communication with new hires ensuring all onboarding tasks are completed in a timely manner, and scheduling new hire orientation sessions.

Maintain integrity of company HCM and third-party systems – such as local payroll providers and global mobility tools – through accurate and timely data processing.

Create new job requisitions (and positions when applicable) in HCM coordinating with cross-functional partners (People Business Partners, Finance, Talent Acquisition, hiring managers) as needed.

Responsible for People Operations offboarding tasks including but not limited to: processing terminations in HCM and third-party systems, coordinating offboard with IT and other departments as needed in accordance with service level agreements, and communication with departing and former employees.

Ensure protection and security of all confidential information through proper controls and discretion. Assist with compliance reporting and audits such as benefit reporting, government filings, and ad hoc reporting requests. Maintain employee files ensuring accuracy, organization, and compliance.

Support for People team initiatives as needed such as: Annual Compensation Review, performance cycles, handbook and policy launches, annual trainings, etc.

Who You Are: 1-3+ years of HR administrative support experience 1+ years Workday HR experience 1+ years with a ticketing service tool (Jira preferred) Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to understand and communicate HR-related information clearly International experience/exposure a plus but not required; preferably HR experience supporting North America and EMEA Familiarity with Excel/Google Sheets (experience with filters, vLookup, formulas, etc. is a plus) Strong organizational skills and attention to detail with ability to work independently and in a fast-paced environment A strong problem-solver with a proactive approach to challenges, able to work independently.

Join the company that’s building the telemetry infrastructure for the AI era. At Cribl , we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality.

As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next. We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market.

Why You’ll Love This Role The Revenue Operations Senior Analyst will play a critical role in supporting Cribl 's Sales organization by delivering data-driven insights on our go-to-market strategy, optimizing systems and processes, and enabling Sales leadership to make strategic decisions with confidence.

You'll partner closely with Sales VPs and cross-functional GTM teams on annual planning, sales compensation, and business performance, helping Cribl scale efficiently as we grow. This role reports to the Sr. Director, Revenue Operations.

As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will… Support annual planning cycles by developing and maintaining segmentation models, territory designs & compensation plans — translating business strategy into actionable coverage plans that align with Cribl 's go-to-market motion Serve as a strategic advisor to Sales VPs by conducting regular business reviews, diagnosing pipeline generation & health opportunities, and recommending data-backed action plans Support and maintain dashboards and reports in Salesforce, Gong & Omni to surface key metrics, trends, and business insights Identify and drive improvements to CRM workflows, data quality, and Revenue tools to reduce friction and increase rep productivity Maintain the integrity of account, opportunity, and territory data in Salesforce, ensuring alignment with segmentation strategy and rules of engagement (ROEs) Work cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Marketing, and People teams to support GTM planning initiatives and operationalize key decisions.

In addition to base salary, for sales and some sales-adjacent roles, employees are eligible to earn incentive compensation (commission). For all other roles, employees are eligible to participate in the Cribl Corporate Bonus Program.

In addition to a competitive salary, Cribl also offers a generous benefits package which includes health, dental, vision, short-term disability, and life insurance, paid holidays and paid time off, a fertility treatment benefit, 401(k), and equity.

Base Salary Range $95,200—$148,750 USD Bring Your Whole Self Diversity drives innovation, enables better decisions to support our customers, and inspires change for the better. We’re building a culture where differences are valued and welcomed, and we work together to bring out the best in each other.

What to Expect: Oversees and manages financial operating budget and day-to-day operations, maintenance, and cleanliness for Onslow Beach area, which is comprised of robust recreation programming, numerous cabins and cottages, RV park/campgrounds, gazebo and conference rooms, and guarded open waters.

Supervises the Assistant General Manager, Maintenance Supervisor, and is the second level supervisor for their teams. Directly responsible for ensuring services and facilities meet or exceed expectations for cleanliness and entertainment.

Develops and directs new policies or innovative promotions to increase occupancy rate, deliver quality guest services and maintain or increase the required level of profitability. Establishes, administers, and maintains systems for safe and secure operations of all facilities at Onslow Beach.

Develops and directs standard operating procedures (SOP) and desktop procedures to ensure consistent operations for guests and staff.

Experience managing a lodging facility, hotel operation, RV park, or campground is preferred.

A Certified Hospitality Supervisor (CHS) credential or other relevant hospitality industry certification is also preferred. Knowledge of safety practices and procedures is essential, along with the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with leadership, employees, public officials, and other stakeholders.

Must possess and maintain a valid driver's license.

Maintain data quality, contact lifecycle processes and the overall integrity of the marketing database.
Identify opportunities to improve the way HubSpot supports Marketing and Sales as the business scales.
Ensure marketing activity is properly tracked and connected to the CRM so engagement can be understood at an individual contact level.

Develop scoring models that help us understand when an existing contact is becoming more engaged or showing increased intent.
Combine signals such as content engagement, website activity, email interactions, campaign participation and other relevant behaviours.
Use scoring to help Sales identify who is becoming more engaged and who should be contacted sooner .
Continuously test and refine scoring logic based on what actually proves useful to Sales.
Clearly communicate engagement signals and changes in contact behaviour to the sales team.
Ensure scoring is used as a prioritisation and intelligence tool, rather than simply as an inbound lead/MQL qualification model.

Develop segmented nurture journeys based on audience, interests, engagement and stage of relationship.
Manage the messaging, sequencing and logic behind automated campaigns.
Test subject lines, messaging, timing, segmentation and calls to action to improve engagement.
Identify opportunities to move contacts between different nurture journeys based on their behaviour.
Monitor campaign performance and continuously optimise programmes based on engagement and commercial outcomes.

Help establish the processes and infrastructure required as Tangible's marketing and sales activity scales.
Act as the internal owner and subject-matter expert for HubSpot marketing operations.

We are looking for a proactive, detail-oriented Operations Coordinator to own the job pipeline from intake through invoice — tracking every active job, driving progress at each stage, and making sure nothing sits without action. This role is the operational engine that keeps jobs moving, keeps the team informed, and keeps the insurance process on track.
A significant portion of this role involves direct communication with insurance companies — calling adjusters, following up on claims, tracking appraisal status, and pushing for updates that allow the team to move forward. This is not a passive role. You flag stalled jobs, escalate when needed, and take initiative to get answers without being asked. If you are organized, persistent, and comfortable on the phone with insurance representatives, this role is built for you.
How the Job Pipeline Works
Understanding the full workflow is essential to succeeding in this role:
A new job comes in — you verify it meets the intake requirements and track it in the system
You ping the sales representative to confirm the inspection date has been set
Once the inspection date is confirmed, the job moves to the next stage and a claim number is assigned
You monitor all active jobs — if a job has been sitting without progress for too long, you bring it to the Operations Manager's attention immediately
You contact the insurance company by phone and email to obtain required claim documents, following up weekly until received
Field technicians go out, take photos, and capture data — that data is entered into the platform to generate the inspection report
You use the report to write the estimate and submit it to the insurance company
Once submitted, you follow up with the insurance company on the appraisal status — calling and emailing until you have an update
You communicate appraisal updates clearly to the internal team
Once approved, the information is sent to invoicing and the job moves forward to completion

Job Intake & Pipeline Tracking
Receive and log incoming jobs, verifying they meet the required criteria before moving them into the active pipeline
Track all active jobs through each stage of the process — from intake through inspection, claim submission, appraisal, and invoice
Maintain an accurate, up-to-date job tracker so the team always knows exactly where each job stands
Proactively identify jobs that have stalled or been sitting without progress and escalate them to the Operations Manager before delays become problems
Sales Team Coordination
Ping sales representatives to confirm inspection dates have been scheduled for new incoming jobs
Follow up consistently until confirmation is received — do not wait for the information to come to you
Move jobs through the pipeline stages as milestones are hit and document each transition
Insurance Company Communication — High Volume
This is one of the most critical and time-intensive parts of the role.
Contact insurance companies by phone and email to request and obtain claim documents, adjuster assignments, and claim numbers
Follow up with insurance representatives weekly — or more frequently when deadlines are approaching — until all required documents and approvals are received
Track the status of submitted estimates and appraisals, calling the insurance company to check on progress and push for updates
Communicate clearly and professionally with adjusters — you know how to be persistent without being difficult
Document all insurance communications including contact names, dates, outcomes, and promised follow-up timelines
Inspection Report & Estimate Support
Coordinate with field technicians to ensure photo and data capture from job sites is submitted in a timely manner
Enter field data into the platform to generate the inspection report
Use the completed inspection report to write the estimate and prepare it for submission to the insurance company
Ensure all estimate submissions are complete, accurate, and sent to the correct insurance contact
Appraisal Process Management
Track all submitted estimates through the appraisal process — logging submission dates and expected response windows
Follow up with the insurance company on the status of submitted appraisals — making calls to confirm receipt, ask for timelines, and request updates
Provide clear, timely appraisal status updates to the internal team so everyone knows where each job stands
Once appraisal decisions are received, communicate the outcome and relevant details to the operations and invoicing team so the job can move forward
Invoicing Handoff
Upon appraisal approval, compile and send the required information to the invoicing team
Ensure all documentation needed to close the job is organized, complete, and transmitted without delay

Prior experience in operations coordination, claims coordination, or a similar role in construction, restoration, roofing, or insurance-related services
Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls to insurance companies, adjusters, and internal team members
Persistent and proactive by nature — you follow up without being asked and escalate before things become urgent
Highly organized with the ability to track multiple active jobs at different stages simultaneously without losing detail
Strong written and verbal communication skills — your phone calls are professional and your documentation is clear
Reliable in a remote environment with a quiet workspace and high-speed internet

Experience working with insurance claims, adjusters, or the property damage restoration process
Familiarity with construction or restoration job management platforms and reporting tools
Background in roofing, storm damage restoration, or property insurance claims coordination
Experience writing estimates or supporting the estimating process in a construction or restoration context
What Makes You a Great Fit
You look at the job tracker every morning and immediately know what needs to move today — without anyone telling you

No job sits in your pipeline without a status, a next action, and a follow-up date
You escalate stalled jobs before the Operations Manager has to ask about them
You are the reason jobs move forward — the team counts on you to keep the pipeline flowing from the first call to the final invoice
